## Required canvas text (keep verbatim)
- Template tương tác • dữ liệu mẫu trong phiên. Chuyển Clinic/Care ở góc trên để duyệt bàn giao.

## Business rules
- The clinic owner has 5 tabs: "Hôm nay" / "Lịch hẹn" / "Hồ sơ" / "Theo dõi" / "Thêm". The bottom nav belongs to Workspace, not a global nav.

## Accepted differences from the canvas
- Real Pema logo instead of the canvas "pema" text.
- Real sample data (46 records) instead of illustrative names.

## Gotchas / notes
- The selected tab must be `rememberSaveable`: NavHost drops `remember` when pushing a child route, so coming back would reset to tab 0.
- The Workspace body is one `LazyColumn` for every tab/role (`ownerItems`/`staffItems`/`careItems` in WorkspaceGraph.kt): add blocks as `item { … }` and tiles with the `tile(...)` helper, never a scrolling `Column` + `forEach` (all rows were composed on each tab switch: ~2 s on a Redmi Note 9 debug build). The `LazyListState` is saved per tab (`rememberSaveable(role, tab)`), so each tab opens at its top and keeps its position after a pushed route.
